name: k10c-copilot-reuse-retention
description: K10c: does the retention policy matter on a real day of agent traffic? K10a's setting with sticky placement and the GPU tier only, under LRU and turn-aware eviction (KV of sessions waiting for their user goes first), each without a lifetime and with a 5-minute or 1-hour one (unreferenced KV dropped).
